page.content:
Isle of apples where the wounded Arthur is borne.

How Avalon connects

  • Character: King Arthur — The wounded Arthur is taken to Avalon.
  • Character: Morgan le Fay — Morgan is among the queens of Avalon.

What is Avalon?

Avalon is the otherworld island of Morgan and the queens. After Camlann, Arthur is taken there to be healed — and, in later hope, to return.

Key threads lead to King Arthur and Morgan le Fay.
